In 17:65, عِبَادِي are named beside the denial of سلطان over them, and the statement of sufficiency and guardianship follows. Authority, servanthood, adequacy, and custody meet the focus condition: its threat applies to the allegiance relation, while the adjacent verse marks a custody boundary.
findings.reader_payoff: The boundary becomes relational, who follows whom and whose custody they are under, rather than a map of territory.
findings.containment: This is a reading of the stated relation in 17:63 and 17:65. It does not turn followers into a geographic zone, define every kind of influence, or settle how any individual moves between the named relations.
